instruction.name: xvffint.s.wu
instruction.description: Convert unsigned 32-bit integer elements in `a` to single-precision floating point numbers.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Register-to-register dependency chain. Source values are normal floats or small integers as appropriate.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvffint.s.wu $xr0, $xr8; xvffint.s.wu $xr1, $xr9; xvffint.s.wu $xr2, $xr10; xvffint.s.wu $xr3, $xr11; xvffint.s.wu $xr4, $xr12; xvffint.s.wu $xr5, $xr13; xvffint.s.wu $xr6, $xr14; xvffint.s.wu $xr7, $xr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvffint.s.wu $xr0, $xr8; xvffint.s.wu $xr1, $xr9; xvffint.s.wu $xr2, $xr10; xvffint.s.wu $xr3, $xr11; xvffint.s.wu $xr4, $xr12; xvffint.s.wu $xr5, $xr13; xvffint.s.wu $xr6, $xr14; xvffint.s.wu $xr7, $xr15'

notes: LASX vector conversion. Measured on LA664 with normal float or small integer source values; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
